title: Central Star Ferry Pier
summary: A quite horrendous toilet, even by public toilet standards.

title: Audemars Piguet (K11 Musea)
summary:
The best toilet I have ever had the opportunity to shit in. The toilet seat is heated, and they have an automated bidet system. The tap water stream is wide, and the water pressure is high. The soap smells like heaven.

Overall, a must-try toilet.
otherNotes: The store has to give you permission to let you in. Dress up, and look like you're trying to buy a watch, and they'll let you in.
